units: <cite ref="Chullin 45a:3">Ḥull. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>נ׳ אחד ארוך</he> one lengthy incision; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נְקָבִים</he>, <he>נְקָבִין</he>.
<cite ref="Chullin 45a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>נ׳ שיש בהן חסרון</he> perforations connected with loss of substance (holes); <he>נ׳ שאין בהן חסרון</he> mere punctures.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 44b:6">Bekh. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>שני נ׳ יש בו וכ׳</he> two channels are in the membrum.
Gen. R. s. 1, beg.; a. fr.—Esp. the organs of the extremities, urinary organ &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 2:18">Tosef. Ber. II, 18</cite> <he>ויהא צריך לנְקָבָיו</he> when needing to ease himself; <cite ref="Berakhot 23a">Ber. 23ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:8">Y. Meg. I, 71ᶜ</cite> <he>לנְקוּבָיו</he>.
